medicina.resumo: NIH-funded clinical trial shows mobile units may help overcome significant barriers to accessing HIV and addiction treatment, but replication is needed.

medicina.titulo: Experimental drug shows promise in overcoming treatment resistance in aggressive acute myeloid leukemia
medicina.resumo: Researchers at the Johns Hopkins Sidney Kimmel Comprehensive Cancer Center and Johns Hopkins Children's Center found that an experimental drug may help overcome one of the major challenges in treating an aggressive subtype of acute myeloid leukemia (AML), known as FLT3-positive AML. In laboratory and animal studies, the drug, called PHI-101, was effective against leukemia cells carrying genetic mutations that cause resistance to existing FLT3-targeted therapies.

biologia.titulo: Protein redesign boosts DNA insertion activity and reveals how molecular machinery selects targets
biologia.resumo: Genome engineering is exciting, given its vast potential to treat and even cure diseases, but it is still a largely uncharted biomedical innovation. Scientists at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital recently uncovered the mechanisms involved in precisely integrating DNA into a target genomic location using CRISPR-associated transposases (CASTs). By studying type I-F3 CAST, the researchers unveiled structural findings that explain how this CAST family achieves successful DNA integration at precise target sites and offer insights for future genomic engineering approaches. The results were published in Nature.

biologia.titulo: Two mechanisms of amino acid transport in a rare disease-associated protein revealed
biologia.resumo: Cells must constantly exchange amino acids with their environment to make proteins and support numerous bodily processes. To do this, they have specialized transporters located in their membranes.

biologia.titulo: Reflorestamento voltado à captura de carbono pode ameaçar a biodiversidade

biologia.titulo: Some miniature Cas12m proteins can cut DNA after all
biologia.resumo: An international research group led by graduate student Hayato Morinaga, Assistant Professor Satoshi N. Omura and Professor Osamu Nureki from the University of Tokyo has demonstrated for the first time that some Cas12m proteins do have an active state capable of cutting, or "cleaving," DNA. The team also clarified the structural differences between the active and inactive variations.

robotica.titulo: Autonomous crane system handles port containers with centimeter-level precision
robotica.resumo: Robotic systems have already been deployed in many factories, industrial sites and warehouses worldwide to automate processes and improve their efficiency. A taxing task that requires the precise control of large machinery is lifting and moving shipping containers in ports.

robotica.titulo: How DARPA Challenged Teams to Bring Robots Into Disaster Triage
robotica.resumo: On 5 November, 10 teams descended upon a 52-acre mock town in College Station, Texas called Disaster City . They were there for a nine-day competition to see how well teams of robots and humans could navigate simulated catastrophes, like a market ravaged by a tornado and a nighttime strike on a military base. At stake? US $2.5 million in prize money. The scenarios were the final of the DARPA Triage Challenge , which the U.S. agency has been running for three years with the goal of saving more lives in urgent mass casualty events. Engineers from academia and industry have competed in elaborately staged mass casualty events , such as simulated combat zones and plane crash scenes. Teams spent years designing systems where autonomous ground robots and drones could help first responders find mock victims and decide the best way to care for them. “Triage is all about resources,” says Jeremy Pamplin , who managed the challenge for DARPA. Pamplin is a critical care physician and retired colonel who spent 28 years in the U.S. Army. In mass casualty events, medics race to assess trauma with finite resources and limited time. robotica.titulo: Robots roam Singapore's urban AI testing ground

robotica.titulo: New method improves state estimation for pneumatic artificial muscle–driven joints
robotica.resumo: Pneumatic artificial muscles (PAMs) are lightweight and flexible, with a high power-to-weight ratio. These properties have made antagonistic PAM-driven joints widely used in soft robotic systems. However, precise and reliable control requires accurate estimates of joint states.

astrofisica.titulo: NASA's Hubble views ocean of stars in groundwork for Roman
astrofisica.resumo: An expanse of stars gleams in a rainbow of colors in these NASA Hubble Space Telescope images of the Milky Way. The images focus on an area of sky toward the galactic bulge, a densely packed, spherical region of stars that surrounds the center of a galaxy's disk. These Hubble observations are part of a survey that will help researchers better interpret upcoming Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope observations as they seek to characterize the stars and search for exoplanets in this busy region of our galaxy.

quantica.titulo: New quantum network entangles 123 qubits that store information in atoms' positions
quantica.resumo: Researchers are constantly getting closer to making practical quantum computers. Now, a team of researchers has overcome another hurdle in the process. Their study, published in Physical Review Letters, describes a new platform for manipulating entangled atomic networks in measurement-based quantum computation—a process usually hindered by difficulties manipulating only one atom or one group of atoms at a time.

quantica.titulo: Ultracold atoms could help unravel a major flaw in quantum theory

computadores_pessoais.resumo: A Thunderbolt laptop docking station offers a serious boost to your productivity, providing support for old and new peripherals alike. It’s a necessity for a home office, but only buy what you need: In 2026, premium Thunderbolt 5 docks might be overkill for a Windows PC. Here, we’ll recommend the best Thunderbolt docks — an overall pick, as well as budget and premium recommendations — based on our own testing of dozens of Thunderbolt docking stations. That testing includes a formal performance evaluation, of course, but also simply using each dock day-in and day-out over an extended period. If you need help deciding what’s best for you, a FAQ at the bottom of the page is there to assist. That FAQ includes an explanation of why I generally lean toward slightly older Thunderbolt 4 docks at the moment. Thunderbolt 5 docks supply 140 watts of power, however, making them very appropriate for a new breed of RTX Spark laptops . Be aware that significantly older laptops often don’t use Thunderbolt. Se tudo correr conforme o planejado, a SpaceX deve lançar a primeira leva dos satélites Starmind no terceiro trimestre do ano que vem . energia_materiais.titulo: Steel industry waste and seashells yield a material that cleans water and produces hydrogen
energia_materiais.resumo: Researchers at the Federal University of São Carlos (UFSCar) and the Federal University of Rio Grande do Norte (UFRN) in Brazil have developed a sustainable nanomaterial from steel industry waste and seashells. When activated by sunlight, the compound can perform two tasks simultaneously: breaking down water pollutants and producing hydrogen (H₂), a promising clean fuel for the energy transition.

energia_materiais.titulo: Rearranging atomic layers reduces voltage decay in high-capacity lithium-ion battery cathodes
energia_materiais.resumo: A new approach for designing cathode materials that could help enhance cycle performance has been proposed. A research team led by professor Kisuk Kang of the Department of Materials Science and Engineering at Seoul National University College of Engineering has identified a principle for suppressing voltage decay through the arrangement of atomic layers in cathode materials. Through experiments and simulations, the researchers found that an "O6 structure," which combines characteristics of different atomic arrangements, reduces structural evolution within the material during cycles.

energia_materiais.titulo: Wolf pack approach to wind and solar power
energia_materiais.resumo: Researchers have developed a new way of managing electricity supplies that could help keep power grids stable as they become more dependent on wind and solar energy. Details of the algorithmic approach, which is based on the hunting behavior of a wolf pack, are reported in the International Journal of Critical Infrastructures.

ciberseguranca.titulo: iPhone 20 Pro pode ganhar edição especial com peças de cerâmica; entenda
ciberseguranca.resumo: iPhone 20 Pro pode ganhar edição especial com peças de cerâmica; entenda A Apple pode lançar uma edição limitada do iPhone 20 Pro com acabamento de cerâmica para comemorar os 20 anos do celular. A informação vem do leaker Fixed Focus Digital, que afirma ter tido acesso a componentes de cerâmica desenvolvidos para o aparelho. A produção prevista seria bastante restrita, o que indica a possibilidade de uma versão especial do smartphone em 2027. Segundo uma publicação do informante na rede social chinesa Weibo, os componentes já estariam em desenvolvimento. 📱 Veja as melhores promoções de hoje no WhatsApp do CT Ofertas Em um comentário posterior, ele explicou que o projeto poderá avançar para a produção em massa caso seja aprovado nos testes de validação de engenharia. O leaker também brincou que a baixa quantidade de unidades poderia fazer o aparelho ganhar valor no mercado de revenda. Só que até o momento, não há confirmação de que a Apple realmente pretende comercializar essa edição. Apple pode apostar em cerâmica no acabamento do iPhone Ainda não está claro qual parte do iPhone 20 Pro receberia o material. O vazamento não especifica se a Apple pretende fabricar a traseira inteira
